previous.changeLog: Fresher MoE thresholds. The per-tank mark targets from the official Wargaming API now refresh on a 7-day cycle instead of monthly, so the combined-damage goals stay current with the game's rebalances. When Wargaming publishes updated numbers, the mod notices on the next fetch and quietly re-pulls the whole set rather than waiting out the cache.

current.changeLog: Maintenance release — internal cleanup and stability improvements. Updating is recommended.
